thread:
alex: Quick ask  need a 1-pager + 3 SDR soundbites for positioning vs cloud AI platforms + infra vendors. Ship to sales by EOD Thu.
jamie: Keep it scannable: 3 claims / 3 proofs / 3 rebuttals. SDRs want one-liners. :thumbsup:
priya: Suggested focus: predictable unit economics, single API across deploy modes, and reliability with graceful fallbacks. Short proof points only.
tom: Also include routing guidance: who gets inbound RFPs, compliance questions, and benchmark requests.
morgan: Field asks we see: "How do you handle tail latency?" "What's rollback ownership?" Keep discovery phrasing for SDRs.
alex: Draft below, paste edits inline:
Claim 1: Predictable inference cost  fewer surprise bills.
Proof: Reserved pools + batching + per-route cost metrics.
Rebuttal: "We autoscale" -> Autoscale = variable spend. Reserved + burst controls give predictability.

Claim 2: Same behavior Hosted/Dedicated/Private.
Proof: One API, same rollout controls, unified observability.
Rebuttal: "We self-host already" -> We support on-prem/VPC with the same control plane so teams don't run two stacks.

Claim 3: Reliability-first serving with graceful fallbacks.
Proof: Policy routing, model variants, KV caching keep apps responsive.
Rebuttal: "We just retry" -> Retries add latency; our routing reduces tail latency without blind retries.
jamie: Add bench blurb: "Typical customers see ~2010% lower per-token cost after batching + caching" with a footnote.
priya: +1 to "typical" and footnote: sample workloads ~1kk req/sec mixed chat/generation.
tom: Inbound routing rules for ops: cost/ops -> #sales-inbound; SLA/compliance -> #ae-enterprise-queue; RFPs/benchmarks -> #field-research.
morgan: SDR one-liners: "Avoid vendor lock  same API across hosted/dedicated/private." "Reserved capacity + per-route cost = predictable spend." "Fallbacks mean degraded answers, not silence."
ops-bot: Draft uploaded: https://redwood.company/drive/marketing/field-onepager-vs-infra (auto-upload).
alex: Thanks. Priya to mock simple diagram. Jamie to run SDR roleplay AM. Will post final to #sales by 5pm. :rocket:
